[LOG 042 – Maintenance Report]

System time: 23:47:12
Status: Active
Access level: Internal

Today's inspection of the main terminal concluded without critical incidents.
Several minor memory access anomalies were detected, but
resolved by restarting the affected modules.

During inspection of the communications bus, the connection
to node B-17 was briefly interrupted. The cause was traced to an
unstable power supply. The issue was mitigated by
rerouting traffic through a redundant line.

Increased latency was also observed when accessing archived log data.
Fragmentation of the storage segments is suspected. Defragmentation
is recommended for the next maintenance cycle.

Notice: Access restrictions for locked entries have been tightened.
Multiple failed attempts will now result in a temporary system lockout.

Final assessment:
System stable, with optimization needed in the storage and network areas.

[LOG 044 – Classified Report]

System time: 01:12:47
Status: Encrypted
Access level: Classified

Unauthorized access to Sector 7G detected. Log data show multiple
unauthorized login attempts from unknown IP addresses. All affected
system modules were immediately quarantined.

Security protocols have been updated: two-factor authentication is now
mandatory for all critical access. Monitoring by AI module Alpha-3
has been activated around the clock.

The investigation is ongoing. Suspicious activity was automatically reported
and isolated.

Final assessment:
System remains stable, but heightened vigilance is required. Distribution
restricted to authorized personnel.
